_about: Heinrich Bullinger (1504-1575) of Zurich: the Decades, translated by 'H. I.' (1577) and edited by Thomas Harding for the Parker Society (4 vols, Cambridge 1849-1852). Named heinrich-bullinger so E. W. Bullinger cannot collide. Internet Archive OCR, raw; each title page read for which Decade it holds (Toronto's own volume numbers differ: its 02 is the Third Decade, 04 the Fourth, 05 the Fifth). The translator is credited only by initials, so no _translators entry. Bullinger's other English works are pending.

bullinger-decades-1: Decades of Henry Bullinger, First and Second Decades, tr. H. I., ed. Thomas Harding (Parker Society, Cambridge, 1849), vol. 1
bullinger-decades-2: Decades of Henry Bullinger, Third Decade, tr. H. I., ed. Thomas Harding (Parker Society, Cambridge, 1850), vol. 2
bullinger-decades-3: Decades of Henry Bullinger, Fourth Decade, tr. H. I., ed. Thomas Harding (Parker Society, Cambridge, 1851), vol. 3
bullinger-decades-4: Decades of Henry Bullinger, Fifth Decade, tr. H. I., ed. Thomas Harding (Parker Society, Cambridge, 1852), vol. 4
